entities.name: Video Experience Infrastructure
entities.description: Plug-and-play SDK to engage and monetize onsite and offsite in-network, delivering embedded video experiences across O&O surfaces.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: The comprehensive SDK that powers onsite personalized feeds and offsite distribution of video assets across partner destinations.

entities.name: Onsite Placement
entities.description: Personalized feeds that drive discovery, engagement, and new revenue across publisher O&O properties.

entities.name: Offsite In-Network
entities.description: Reach and distribution of video assets across the Genuin Network of partner destinations with extended programmatic placements.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Advertiser ads or content inserted within O&O content carousels, feeds, and grids, sold direct or programmatically via DealID on a CPM basis.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: 100% SOV carousels, feeds, and grids for advertising partners across O&O app/web surfaces, sold direct by Publisher as CPM.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Stream
entities.description: Preroll, midroll, and endroll placements of partner advertising on publisher content, bought and sold programmatically via DealID on a CPM basis.

entities.name: Session Takeover
entities.description: 100% session SOV via multiple placements of partner advertising across the user session, bought programmatically via DealID.

entities.name: Audience Extension
entities.description: Programmatic in-feed and in-stream extended placements that maximize margin via audience extension and bundle partnerships.

entities.name: Video Carousel Format
entities.description: 9:16 vertical video format under 5 minutes with multiple linkout overlays used across sponsored placements.

entities.name: DealID
entities.description: Programmatic deal identifier mechanism used to buy and sell Genuin sponsored placements and in-stream inventory.

entities.name: Unified Data Delivery
entities.description: Raw data delivery covering reach, time spent, engagement, performance by content, link actions, and monetization for ingest into publisher analytic platforms.

entities.name: Extended O&O Sponsorships
entities.description: Offsite in-network sponsorship product that maximizes margin via audience extension and bundles partnerships across the network.

entities.name: Extended Brand Experiences
entities.description: Growth offering for offsite in-network that configures funnel, relevance, and discovery and supports timely brand initiatives.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Network of trusted partner sites with 237MM reach and 4B impressions per month where brand assets are distributed to engaged audiences.

entities.name: Extended Audience
entities.description: Programmatic scale audience pool of 1.2BB+ reach extending the Genuin Network's onsite distribution.

entities.name: Consumers
entities.description: End users receiving contextually relevant feeds providing content, offers, and social interaction across publisher surfaces.

entities.name: Brands and Advertisers
entities.description: Buyers whose assets are distributed across the Genuin Network of trusted sites to reach engaged audiences at scale.

entities.name: Publishers
entities.description: O&O property owners who set CPM costs and floors, sell direct and programmatic inventory, and host Genuin video experiences across home pages, articles, tabs, and PDPs.

entities.name: Us Magazine
entities.description: Publisher destination referenced as a live example of Genuin video experience deployment.

entities.name: Daily Faceoff
entities.description: Partner content brand featured in 'Brought to you by Daily Faceoff' Highlights and the Zamboni Nation curated extended brand experience.

entities.name: Action Network
entities.description: Partner curating the 'Built for Action' extended O&O sponsorship example used to illustrate audience extension margin.

entities.name: Better Collective
entities.description: Partner organization addressed by this April 2026 M1 proposal deck outlining Genuin's onsite and offsite monetization offering.

entities.name: Brand Content
entities.description: Brand-supplied video assets used to power onsite and offsite placements alongside social and partner content.

entities.name: Creator UGC
entities.description: Optional creator and user-generated content used to power feed experiences across O&O and in-network destinations.

entities.name: CPM Pricing Model
entities.description: Cost-per-mille pricing model applied across Sponsored Post, Sponsored Takeover, Programmatic In-Stream, and Session Takeover, with publishers setting prices or floors.

entities.name: Partnership Sales
entities.description: Genuin's partnership sales function responsible for closing publisher and advertiser deals, represented by Peter Bavaro on this proposal.

entities.name: Peter Bavaro
entities.description: Genuin Partnership Sales contact (peter@begenuin.com) representing the company on the Better Collective M1 April 2026 proposal.

entities.name: Matt Wurst
entities.description: Chief Marketing Officer at Genuin (matt@begenuin.com), co-signing the Better Collective M1 April 2026 proposal.

relationships.description: The Video Experience Infrastructure is delivered as a comprehensive plug-and-play SDK.
The SDK powers personalized onsite feeds across publisher O&O properties.
The SDK powers offsite in-network distribution of video assets across partner destinations.
Sponsored Post is an onsite monetization placement within content carousels, feeds, and grids.
Sponsored Takeover is an onsite 100% SOV placement for advertising partners across O&O surfaces.
Programmatic In-Stream preroll, midroll, and endroll placements are part of the onsite monetization mix.
Session Takeover delivers 100% session SOV via multiple placements throughout a user session onsite.
Audience Extension provides extended programmatic in-feed and in-stream placements offsite.
Extended O&O Sponsorships are an offsite in-network monetization product.
Extended Brand Experiences are an offsite in-network growth product supporting brand initiatives.
Sponsored Post placements use the 9:16 vertical video carousel format with linkout overlays.
Sponsored Takeover placements use the 9:16 vertical video carousel format.
Programmatic In-Stream placements use the 9:16 vertical video carousel format with linkout overlays.
Sponsored Post inventory can be bought programmatically via DealID.
Programmatic In-Stream inventory is bought and sold programmatically via DealID.
Session Takeover inventory is bought programmatically via DealID.
Sponsored Post is priced on a CPM basis set by the Publisher.
Sponsored Takeover is sold by Publisher as CPM for the advertiser's experience load.
Programmatic In-Stream uses a CPM model with floor set by Publisher.
Session Takeover is sold as programmatic CPM impressions with floor set by Publisher.
Offsite in-network distribution operates across the Genuin Network of partner destinations.
The Genuin Network's reach is extended via programmatic scale to 1.2BB+ Extended Audience reach.
Brands and advertisers distribute their assets across the Genuin Network of trusted partner sites.
Publishers deploy onsite placements across home pages, articles, tabs, and PDPs on their O&O app/web surfaces.
Onsite personalized feeds deliver contextually relevant content, offers, and social interaction to consumers.
Brand, social, and partner content power onsite and offsite in-network feed experiences.
Optional creator and user-generated content power onsite and offsite in-network feed experiences.
Us Magazine is shown as a live example of a publisher running the Genuin video experience SDK.
The Zamboni Nation extended brand experience is curated by Daily Faceoff.
The 'Built for Action' extended O&O sponsorship example is curated by Action Network.
Sponsored Post Highlights creative is shown 'Brought to you by Daily Faceoff' as an onsite example.
Peter Bavaro leads the Partnership Sales contact on the Better Collective M1 April 2026 proposal.
Matt Wurst, CMO, co-signs the partnership sales proposal to Better Collective.
Genuin's Partnership Sales function is pitching the M1 April 2026 proposal to Better Collective.
Unified raw data on reach, engagement, and monetization is delivered to publishers' analytic platforms.
